visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a white sleeveless dress and a light green crochet cardigan, is seated on a brown leather sofa. She has a distressed facial expression with tears in her eyes, looking directly at the camera. The background is a plain white wall, and the scene is lit with bright, soft studio light. (2) A young man wearing glasses and a grey jacket appears, acting as a director. He gestures animatedly with his hands while holding a picture of a muscular man. The woman looks at him with a weary expression. The lighting remains consistent, and the setting is the same indoor studio environment. (3) The woman begins to cry dramatically, her face contorting with grief. As she cries, a visual effect of water spraying like a fountain erupts from her eyes, soaking her face and hair. The camera zooms in on her wet face. The background remains unchanged, though graphic droplets are added as overlays. (4) The director character holds up a purple L'Oreal product tube toward the camera. The woman touches her face, looking surprised. Close-up shots show the woman's hands applying the cream to her eye area. The packaging is metallic purple. A split-screen comparison shows Before and After results on her face. (5) The woman, now in a glamorous black sequined strapless dress, poses against a white curtain background. She winks and smiles at the camera, showing no signs of puffy eyes. The scene transitions back to the studio where she sits at a table with two product tubes, speaking enthusiastically to the audience while gesturing. (6) The director suggests a final scene involving mud. The woman’s expression shifts to one of annoyance and frustration, her eyebrows furrowed as she speaks sharply back at the man. The lighting remains bright, and variety-show style emojis appear around her to emphasize her reaction.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A mournful, slow-tempo piano melody plays in the background while a female voice is heard sobbing with high pitch variability and a clear sense of emotional distress. There is no other ambient noise. (2) A sharp, percussive clack sound occurs, marking a hard cut. A male voice speaks rapidly with a professional yet comedic tone, exhibiting high arousal and a clear delivery. (3) High-energy, upbeat electronic pop music fades in at a moderate volume. The female voice resumes crying but with an exaggerated, comedic tone. A distinct splashing sound effect is layered over the music. (4) A bright whoosh transition SFX plays. The male voice takes on a narrative, persuasive tone as he describes product benefits. A ding sound effect highlights key visual points. (5) The female voice becomes the dominant speaker, maintaining a friendly and animated tone. The BGM continues throughout at a lower volume to ensure vocal clarity. Periodic pop and sparkle sound effects coincide with visual labels. (6) The track features a final dialogue exchange between the two speakers. The male voice suggests a new scene, followed by a comedic boing SFX. The female voice responds with an aggressive, loud tone of protest before the audio cuts abruptly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Skit Hook -> Problem (Puffy Eyes) -> Solution (L'Oreal Eye Cream) -> Feature Demo -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote L'Oreal Paris eye cream products by using a humorous behind-the-scenes skit format to demonstrate how the products effectively reduce puffiness and dark circles caused by crying.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, verbal endorsement of benefits, and clear brand logos throughout the second half of the video.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a high-energy, social-media-native editing style with variety-show captions and meme-like sound effects to make a commercial for skincare more relatable and entertaining.
